fly.condition: only if you're wearing light armor

entries.name: Molt
entries: As an {@variantrule Action|XPHB}, you may shed your skin for increased movement speed (45) for two turns.

entries.name: Multi-Limbed
entries: You have four arms, and may perform any {@variantrule Action|XPHB} that require a free hand with two hands full.

entries.name: Silken Wings
entries: You have moth-like wings that allow you to fly the same distance as your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. This only applies while wearing Light Armor.

entries.name: Lightweight Structure
entries: You do not take damage from falls below 30 feet.

entries.name: Coleo Exoskeleton
entries: You have a hard exoskeleton that gives you a +2 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Mandibles
entries: You have mandibles that allow you to make a bite attack. This attack deals 1d4 piercing damage, and is considered a natural weapon.

entries.name: Chitinous Wings
entries: You have chitinous wings that allow you to fly at your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Burrowing
entries: You can burrow through dirt and sand at a speed of 10 feet. You cannot burrow through stone or metal.

entries.name: Stinger
entries: You have a stinger that allows you to make a sting attack. This attack deals 1d4 piercing damage, and is considered a natural weapon.

entries.name: Wings
entries: You have wings that allow you to fly at your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Pheromones
entries: You can emit pheromones that allow you to communicate with other Hymeno. This communication is limited to simple emotions and intentions.

entries.name: Exoskeleton
entries: You have a hard exoskeleton that gives you a +1 bonus to AC.

entries.name: Webbing
entries: You can spin webbing that allow you to create a web that can be used to trap creatures. The web has an AC of 10 and 5 hit points. It takes 1 minute to create a web.

entries.name: Venomous Bite
entries: You have a venomous bite that allows you to make a bite attack. This attack deals 1d4 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage.

entries.name: Climbing
entries: You can climb on walls and ceilings at your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Spider's Sense
entries: You gain Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Many Legs
entries: You have many legs that allow you to move quickly. You gain a +10 bonus to your walking speed.

entries.name: Venomous Bite
entries: You have a venomous bite that allows you to make a bite attack. This attack deals 1d4 piercing damage, and the target must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or take 1d4 poison damage.
